control.$description: Corners of controls: buttons, inputs, and selects, so a row of controls shares one shape. 8px (radius/md) in the soft shape, fully rounded (radius/full) in the round one.

container.$description: Corners of containers: cards, panels, dialogs, and sheets, so the surfaces of a page share one shape. 8px (radius/md) in the soft shape, 32px (radius/2xl) in the round one.
